title: Borel measurability of the blow-up integrals in the definition of approximate tangent planes
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be any set such that ν := Hⁿ⌞M (μHE[n].restrict M) is s-finite. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous with f(y) ≥ 0 for all y, and let r > 0. For x ∈ ℝ^P let η_x(y) := r⁻¹(y − x) (SimonGMT blowUpMap x r). Then the real function x ↦ ∫_{η_x(M)} f dHⁿ is Borel measurable on ℝ^P. This is the Bochner integral of f against Hⁿ⌞η_x(M), the integral in Simon's Definition 1.4 of approximate tangent planes, and it is 0 when f is not integrable there.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), SFinite (μHE[n].restrict M) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Measurable (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y ∂μHE[n])
